text:
Aliaksei Protas keeps getting the looks and keeps missing. He has 2 goals on 4.89 expected through 21 games, a 5.7% shooting rate for a player whose talent range sits well above 11%. Goals tend to follow chances, and his are real.

The rest of his game has been good. Washington takes 55% of the expected goals at 5-on-5 with him on the ice, and he has 9 points in his last ten games, eight of them assists. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says 61% of his exits leave the zone with possession, the kind of quiet skill that keeps the puck moving the right way. Evolving-Hockey had him driving offense at a 92nd percentile rate last season, with the warning that chances against rose too (bottom 10%).

He scored 25 goals in 76 games last season. Watch the shooting: once a couple go in, the point total should look like his play.
